values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Rustic state forest campground on the east side of Little Lake, shaded by upland hardwoods and lowland conifers, 5 mi E of Gwinn via M-35 South and Little Lake Road (Marquette County); managed by the DNR Escanaba Field Office. Small beach in the middle of the campground; carry-in paddling access about 20 yards from the parking area. Take refuse to the dumpsters at the Gwinn Field Office. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: 16 sites for tent/small/large trailers with pull-throughs 6, 8, 12 (count and pull_through confirmed), $20 at the kiosk + Recreation Passport, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, boat launch, first-come only, 15-day maximum (all confirmed). Season (open all year, roads not plowed) already manual and matches the page. Pin matches the DNR directions point. Not equestrian (type 'rustic'). Note trimmed of field restatements.
